Original Armor & Glory faith-centered artwork

 Pre-curved visor and adjustable plastic snap closure

 Front embroidery made for a clear, readable statement

 One size fits most

 Made to order

 NO WEAPON FORMED — Isaiah 54:17 is a reminder to carry this message into ordinary days, conversations, work, workouts, and worship. The design keeps the scripture reference visible while staying easy to style with tees, hoodies, denim, or activewear.
story.specifications:
Blank: OTTO Cap 39-165 foam trucker hat

 Front: 100% polyester structured foam panel with embroidery

 Back: Breathable mesh

 Shape: High-profile five-panel silhouette with pre-curved visor

 Closure: Adjustable plastic snap

 Fit: One size fits most

 Colorways: Black and Dark Navy

 Fit guide 
 One size fits most with an adjustable plastic snap closure. Product dimensions are 24.02–25.98 in (61–66 cm) circumference, 5.98 in (15.2 cm) height, 8.58 in (21.8 cm) width, and 2.99 in (7.6 cm) panel height. These are product dimensions; compare them with a favorite hat before ordering.

 Frequently asked questions 
 Is this hat adjustable? 
Yes. The plastic snap closure lets you customize the fit.

 Is it embroidered? 
Yes. The NO WEAPON FORMED — Isaiah 54:17 lockup is embroidered on the structured foam front.

 Is it one size? 
Yes. It is a one-size-fits-most trucker hat with an adjustable snap.

 How should I care for it? 
Spot clean with warm water, dish soap, and a soft brush. Do not soak the entire hat or place it in a washing machine or dryer.

 Is it made to order? 
Yes. Each hat is produced for your order, so allow production time before shipping.

 Production note 
 Because each piece is made to order, minor variations in color, embroidery placement, or appearance may occur. Delivery estimates depend on destination and the selected sales channel.

 Heavenly Numbers is an original design from the Graffiti Faith Derivatives collection, adapted for lightweight EVA foam clogs.

• Please review the size chart carefully before ordering. If you are between sizes or prefer a closer fit, consider choosing the smaller size. Fit may vary based on foot width and personal preference.

 Frequently Asked Questions

Yes. It combines a rigid polycarbonate outer shell with a shock-absorbing TPU inner liner for durable everyday protection.

 Is this a MagSafe case? 
Yes. The case includes a built-in magnetic module compatible with MagSafe® chargers, wallets, and other MagSafe® compatible accessories.

 Does it support wireless charging? 
Yes. The case is compatible with wireless charging and includes a built-in magnetic module for MagSafe® compatible accessories.

 Can I choose the finish? 
Yes. Select either glossy or matte before adding the case to your cart.

 Will the artwork cover the sides?

title: Samson Breaking Pillars Gym Tee

story.summary: Mainstream fitness is hollow vanity. True strength is redemptive. You clicked because you are tired of a gym culture obsessed with the mirror. So are we. We built this for the person who knows real strength is not just physical—it comes from God.

rawBody:
Mainstream fitness is hollow vanity. True strength is redemptive. You clicked because you are tired of a gym culture obsessed with the mirror. So are we. We built this for the person who knows real strength is not just physical—it comes from God.

 This Samson Strength tee is a bold, unapologetic Christian gym shirt inspired by the moment Samson prays for strength one more time. The design connects faith, failure, redemption, and power in a way that feels raw, masculine, and wearable.

 The Story & Scripture Focus 

 “Then Samson prayed to the Lord, ‘Sovereign Lord, remember me. Please, God, strengthen me just once more…’” — Judges 16:28

 Samson’s final prayer is not clean or polished. It is desperate, honest, and powerful. After failure, weakness, betrayal, and loss, he still turns back to God and asks for strength. His final act of breaking the pillars wasn't about flexing for a crowd or personal glory—it was a brutal surrender of his physical strength to a higher, divine purpose.

 That is what this shirt is about. Not perfect strength. Redeemed strength. Strength that comes from God when there is nothing left to fake.

 The Fit, Feel & Print Forget cheap, paper-thin church merch. This tee is printed on the legendary Comfort Colors® 1717 , known for its authentic, broken-in feel straight out of the box. We use high-quality Direct-to-Garment (DTG) printing, meaning the ink absorbs directly into the heavyweight fabric for a true vintage look—no cheap, stiff plastic sitting heavy on your back while you train.

 The Details 

 The Fabric: Heavyweight 100% ring-spun cotton. Garment-dyed for a rich, vintage washed look.

 The Mark: A minimal "XVI" (16) on the front pocket area, pointing to Judges chapter 16.

 The Art: A bold, oversized vintage woodcut illustration of Samson dominating the back.

 The Aesthetic: Designed for the iron paradise. Perfect as a gym pump cover, faith-based workout gear, or a casual streetwear staple.

 Sizing & Care 

 Sizing: Unisex sizing. Fits true to size for men. (Pro-Tip: Size up for a highly aggressive, oversized pump cover look). Women can order true to size for a relaxed streetwear fit, or size down for a closer fit.

 Care: Machine wash cold, inside out. Tumble dry low. Avoid bleach to preserve the garment-dyed color and vintage print. Do not iron directly on the design.

 Product Q&A 
 What does this Samson shirt mean? This shirt is inspired by Judges 16:28, when Samson asks God to strengthen him one more time. The design represents redemptive strength, faith after failure, and power that comes from God.

 Is this a Christian gym shirt? Yes. The bold Samson back graphic, heavyweight cotton, and relaxed fit make it a strong choice for Christian gym wear, pump cover outfits, and faith-based workout apparel.

 What Bible verse is this shirt based on? The shirt is based on Judges 16:28, where Samson prays for God to remember him and strengthen him again.

 What does XVI mean on the front? XVI means 16 in Roman numerals. It points to Judges chapter 16, the chapter where Samson’s final prayer appears.

 Is the design only for men? No. The shirt is unisex, but the design has a bold, rugged, masculine feel that works especially well for men’s Christian streetwear and gym outfits.

 Is this a good Christian gift? Yes. This makes a strong Christian gift for men, gym lovers, Bible study groups, youth leaders, pastors, and anyone who connects with the story of Samson.

title: Be Not Afraid Seraphim Social Club T-Shirt | Angelic Seraphim Illustration

story.summary: The Hidden Meaning Behind the Design If you are looking closely at the central eye and the six wings, there is a reason they are there.
story.meaningBehindDesign:
If you are looking closely at the central eye and the six wings, there is a reason they are there.

 Mainstream culture has watered angels down, but scripturally, the Seraphim are awe-inspiring beings that stand directly in the presence of God.

 The Central Eye: A historic symbol of divine omniscience—the comforting, yet terrifying reality that God sees exactly where you are.

 The Six Wings: Representing absolute, raw reverence.

 When a being with this much terrifying power tells humanity to "Be Not Afraid," it actually means something. We built this design to reclaim that unapologetic power.

 Be Not Afraid Seraphim Social Club T Shirt 

 This Be Not Afraid Seraphim Social Club shirt brings together biblically accurate angel imagery, gothic faith art, and modern Christian streetwear. The design is inspired by the six winged Seraphim from Isaiah’s throne room vision, giving the piece a bold, reverent, and slightly mysterious look.

 This is not your typical Christian shirt. It is made for people who love Scripture, ancient biblical imagery, theology, sacred art, gothic design, and faith based clothing that feels different from the usual church merch.
story.whyYouWillLoveIt:
• Bold Seraphim inspired front graphic • “Be Not Afraid” message with a dark sacred art feel • Modern Christian streetwear style • Great for theology nerds, Bible readers, church creatives, and fans of biblical angel imagery • Easy to wear with jeans, cargos, jackets, hoodies, or layered streetwear fits • Unisex sizing for an everyday relaxed look 

 Style notes 

 This shirt works well as gothic Christian apparel, biblical angel streetwear, theology themed clothing, or a faith based graphic tee with a darker artistic edge. It is bold without being cheesy, scriptural without looking like a church event shirt, and strange in the best possible way.
story.specifications:
• Black unisex T shirt • Front graphic design • Soft everyday feel • Comfortable fit for daily wear • Available in multiple sizes • Designed for faith, streetwear, and conversation

 Care 

 Machine wash cold with similar colors. Turn inside out before washing. Tumble dry low or hang dry for best results. Do not iron directly over the graphic.

 Q&A 

 What does the Seraphim design mean? The design is inspired by the six winged Seraphim described in Isaiah 6. It reflects holiness, awe, worship, and the mystery of God’s throne room imagery.

 Is “Be Not Afraid” a biblical phrase? Yes. The phrase reflects the repeated biblical theme of God and His messengers telling people not to fear. This design connects that message with angelic imagery and sacred art.

 Is this a Christian shirt? Yes. This is a Christian graphic T shirt with a biblically inspired angel design, created for people who want faith based apparel with more depth and visual edge.

 Who is this shirt good for? It is great for Bible readers, theology nerds, pastors, worship leaders, church creatives, gothic faith fans, and anyone who likes Christian streetwear that feels bold and different.

 How does it fit? This is a unisex T shirt with an easy everyday fit. For a more relaxed streetwear look, consider sizing up.
